children.description:
The meaning of the word 'hangry' is when someone becomes angry or cranky due to hunger. It is a combination of the words hungry and angry. An example usage is "I've been waiting for half an hour for that burger, I'm so hangry! The service at this restaurant is trash!" The author details for this definition are Jadestonecool and the definition was written on April 28, 2019. 

For a random word, we have "Armita," which refers to a very beautiful girl with a boyfriend named Siavash. The author of this definition is siaavaash and it was written on September 14, 2010. An example usage is "That girl is so beautiful, she's such an Armita."

The word of the day for today is "Facekini," which is a mask designed for swimmers and beachgoers that covers the head and reveals only the eyes, nose, and mouth. It was invented by Zhang Shifan in 2012 and has become a fashion trend despite its original use for protecting one's face from the sun and irritants. The author is bruhdisease and the definition was written on June 24.
